```{r}
df = read.csv("HT_2013-2025.csv")
```

## New Model (From Amber)

```{r}
# 1. Consistent panel: agencies that reported in every year of the chosen window

start_year <- 2016   # a researcher decision (see below)

window_df <- df |>
  filter(DATA_YEAR >= start_year)

n_years <- n_distinct(window_df$DATA_YEAR)

panel_agencies <- window_df |>
  group_by(ORI) |>
  summarise(years_reported = n_distinct(DATA_YEAR)) |>
  filter(years_reported == n_years) |>
  pull(ORI)

panel_df <- window_df |>
  filter(ORI %in% panel_agencies)

# 2. Yearly totals by subcategory
yearly <- panel_df |>
  group_by(DATA_YEAR, OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME) |>
  summarise(total = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT), .groups = "drop")

lm(log(total) ~ DATA_YEAR * OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME, data = yearly)
```
